role_reviews.adversarial_falsification: The two cases exhaust every current prefix by p31; in the p31=0 case only a+=4/6 exist and both have p7..p9=100.
role_reviews.analogy_transfer: Marginal protocol fields fail to compose into a whole message, but the analogy supplies no authority.
role_reviews.domain_theory: The separator applies to all exact support cells and does not depend on H_31 emptiness.
role_reviews.formal_methods: The h-to-parent coordinate mapping h[j]=x[30+j] makes h7..h9 exactly parent payload token 7; 00 is illegal for v=2 or 3.
role_reviews.research_value: The result identifies a later full-word obstruction and a better next-screening coordinate; it is not a lower bound.

strongest_objection: Could a current a+=1 prefix have p31=0? No: its first32 endpoint is the index bit of the eighth literal, and v+=1 forces code 1.
